PROFILE SUMMARY
Senior Business Analyst & Product Owner | 8.5+ Years | Cards, Fintech & Payments Specialist: Dynamic and result-oriented professional with 8.5 years of experience spanning Business Analysis, Product Management, and Scrum Master roles within high-stakes banking and payment ecosystems. I possess a proven track record in driving large- scale digital transformations, specializing in ISO 20022 (MX) and ISO 8583 (MT) migrations, AI/ML-driven fraud management, and core banking modernization.
